aura.auras.eletrica.desc: Lightning crackles across the body, plasma orbs circle around and bolts strike the ground.
aura.auras.fogo.desc: Flames rise along the body and in a ring at your feet, with two fire serpents spiraling up.
aura.auras.lava.desc: A cracked magma pool, glowing rocks in orbit and lava dripping and splashing.
aura.auras.gelo.desc: Ice crystals orbit in two rings while snow falls and a cold mist covers the ground.
aura.auras.sombra.desc: A void vortex drains the light around you, with black smoke and dark orbs.
aura.auras.natureza.desc: Leaves spiral upward, fireflies dance and flowers bloom wherever you walk.
aura.auras.divina.desc: A golden halo, wings of light, holy beams and feathers drifting down.
aura.auras.cosmica.desc: Orbital rings with planets, colorful nebulae and shooting stars.
aura.auras.pokebola.desc: Orbiting Poké Balls that burst open with energy, shiny sparkles and a Poké Ball emblem on the ground.
aura.auras.kokusen.desc: Black lightning with a red glow crackles on your fists. The punch charges and bursts into lightning tendrils that crack the ground.
aura.auras.vampiro.desc: Astral bats fly around you, a blood moon behind your head, crimson mist and rose petals.
aura.auras.necromante.desc: Undead illusions rise from the ground and fade into souls, with ghost skulls and soul fire.
